tours.name: Finance: Print a Cheque for a Vendor Payment ( Bill - Cheque Payment - Print ) - Full Flow

name_i18n.en_US: Finance: Print a Cheque for a Vendor Payment ( Bill - Cheque Payment - Print ) - Full Flow
name_i18n.si_LK: Finance: Print a Cheque for a Vendor Payment ( Bill - Cheque Payment - Print ) - Full Flow
name_i18n.ta_IN: Finance: Print a Cheque for a Vendor Payment ( Bill - Cheque Payment - Print ) - Full Flow

tours.description: Set up cheque numbering on the Vendor Payment - Commercial bank journal, create and post a vendor bill, register the payment with the Checks payment method, and print the cheque from the payment.

description_i18n.en_US: Set up cheque numbering on the Vendor Payment - Commercial bank journal, create and post a vendor bill, register the payment with the Checks payment method, and print the cheque from the payment.
description_i18n.si_LK: Set up cheque numbering on the Vendor Payment - Commercial bank journal, create and post a vendor bill, register the payment with the Checks payment method, and print the cheque from the payment.
description_i18n.ta_IN: Set up cheque numbering on the Vendor Payment - Commercial bank journal, create and post a vendor bill, register the payment with the Checks payment method, and print the cheque from the payment.

steps.title: Open hidden menus
steps.content: Click the ' + ' button in the Accounting menu bar to reveal the hidden menus, including Configuration.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the ' + ' button in the Accounting menu bar to reveal the hidden menus, including Configuration.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the ' + ' button in the Accounting menu bar to reveal the hidden menus, including Configuration.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click the ' + ' button in the Accounting menu bar to reveal the hidden menus, including Configuration.

steps.title: Journals
steps.content: Scroll down to the Configuration section and click Journals. The cheque numbering is set on the bank journal you pay vendors from.

content_i18n.en_US: Scroll down to the Configuration section and click Journals. The cheque numbering is set on the bank journal you pay vendors from.
content_i18n.si_LK: Scroll down to the Configuration section and click Journals. The cheque numbering is set on the bank journal you pay vendors from.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Scroll down to the Configuration section and click Journals. The cheque numbering is set on the bank journal you pay vendors from.

steps.title: Search the bank journal
steps.content: Type "Vendor Payment - Commercial" in the search box and press Enter to filter the journal list.

content_i18n.en_US: Type "Vendor Payment - Commercial" in the search box and press Enter to filter the journal list.
content_i18n.si_LK: Type "Vendor Payment - Commercial" in the search box and press Enter to filter the journal list.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Type "Vendor Payment - Commercial" in the search box and press Enter to filter the journal list.

steps.title: Vendor Payment - Commercial
steps.content: Click the Vendor Payment - Commercial journal to open its configuration form.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Vendor Payment - Commercial journal to open its configuration form.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the Vendor Payment - Commercial journal to open its configuration form.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click the Vendor Payment - Commercial journal to open its configuration form.

steps.title: Outgoing Payments
steps.content: Open the Outgoing Payments tab. Make sure the payment method "Checks" is listed here - it is what makes cheque printing available on payments from this journal.

content_i18n.en_US: Open the Outgoing Payments tab. Make sure the payment method "Checks" is listed here - it is what makes cheque printing available on payments from this journal.
content_i18n.si_LK: Open the Outgoing Payments tab. Make sure the payment method "Checks" is listed here - it is what makes cheque printing available on payments from this journal.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Open the Outgoing Payments tab. Make sure the payment method "Checks" is listed here - it is what makes cheque printing available on payments from this journal.

steps.title: Checks
steps.content: The "Checks" line must be present in Outgoing Payments. If it is missing, click Add a line and select Checks.

content_i18n.en_US: The "Checks" line must be present in Outgoing Payments. If it is missing, click Add a line and select Checks.
content_i18n.si_LK: The "Checks" line must be present in Outgoing Payments. If it is missing, click Add a line and select Checks.
content_i18n.ta_IN: The "Checks" line must be present in Outgoing Payments. If it is missing, click Add a line and select Checks.

steps.title: Manual Numbering
steps.content: Tick Manual Numbering so Odoo assigns a running cheque number to every cheque payment from this journal. (If it is already ticked, leave it on and simply click it once to continue.)

content_i18n.en_US: Tick Manual Numbering so Odoo assigns a running cheque number to every cheque payment from this journal. (If it is already ticked, leave it on and simply click it once to continue.)
content_i18n.si_LK: Tick Manual Numbering so Odoo assigns a running cheque number to every cheque payment from this journal. (If it is already ticked, leave it on and simply click it once to continue.)
content_i18n.ta_IN: Tick Manual Numbering so Odoo assigns a running cheque number to every cheque payment from this journal. (If it is already ticked, leave it on and simply click it once to continue.)

steps.title: Next Cheque Number
steps.content: Enter the number printed on the next blank cheque leaf in your cheque book. Odoo will use it for the next cheque and then increase it automatically.

content_i18n.en_US: Enter the number printed on the next blank cheque leaf in your cheque book. Odoo will use it for the next cheque and then increase it automatically.
content_i18n.si_LK: Enter the number printed on the next blank cheque leaf in your cheque book. Odoo will use it for the next cheque and then increase it automatically.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Enter the number printed on the next blank cheque leaf in your cheque book. Odoo will use it for the next cheque and then increase it automatically.

steps.title: Save journal
steps.content: Click the cloud icon to save the journal. Cheque numbering is now configured.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the cloud icon to save the journal. Cheque numbering is now configured.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the cloud icon to save the journal. Cheque numbering is now configured.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click the cloud icon to save the journal. Cheque numbering is now configured.

steps.title: Vendors
steps.content: Now create the vendor bill. Click the Vendors menu.

content_i18n.en_US: Now create the vendor bill. Click the Vendors menu.
content_i18n.si_LK: Now create the vendor bill. Click the Vendors menu.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Now create the vendor bill. Click the Vendors menu.

steps.title: Bills
steps.content: Click Bills to open the list of vendor bills.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Bills to open the list of vendor bills.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Bills to open the list of vendor bills.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Bills to open the list of vendor bills.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start a new vendor bill.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start a new vendor bill.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click New to start a new vendor bill.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click New to start a new vendor bill.

steps.title: Select the vendor
steps.content: Type the vendor name and pick it from the list. For this exercise use MARS ELECTRIC.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the vendor name and pick it from the list. For this exercise use MARS ELECTRIC.
content_i18n.si_LK: Type the vendor name and pick it from the list. For this exercise use MARS ELECTRIC.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Type the vendor name and pick it from the list. For this exercise use MARS ELECTRIC.

steps.title: Bill Date
steps.content: Enter the date on the vendor's invoice. The due date is calculated from it.

content_i18n.en_US: Enter the date on the vendor's invoice. The due date is calculated from it.
content_i18n.si_LK: Enter the date on the vendor's invoice. The due date is calculated from it.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Enter the date on the vendor's invoice. The due date is calculated from it.

steps.title: Journal
steps.content: Click the Journal and choose Vendor Bills, so the bill is booked in the normal purchase journal.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Journal and choose Vendor Bills, so the bill is booked in the normal purchase journal.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the Journal and choose Vendor Bills, so the bill is booked in the normal purchase journal.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click the Journal and choose Vendor Bills, so the bill is booked in the normal purchase journal.

steps.title: Add a line
steps.content: In the Invoice Lines tab click Add a line to enter what you are being billed for.

content_i18n.en_US: In the Invoice Lines tab click Add a line to enter what you are being billed for.
content_i18n.si_LK: In the Invoice Lines tab click Add a line to enter what you are being billed for.
content_i18n.ta_IN: In the Invoice Lines tab click Add a line to enter what you are being billed for.

steps.title: Line description
steps.content: Type a description for the line, for example: Electrical spare parts - training bill.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a description for the line, for example: Electrical spare parts - training bill.
content_i18n.si_LK: Type a description for the line, for example: Electrical spare parts - training bill.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Type a description for the line, for example: Electrical spare parts - training bill.

steps.title: Unit price
steps.content: Click the Price cell and enter the amount of the bill, for example 25,000.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Price cell and enter the amount of the bill, for example 25,000.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the Price cell and enter the amount of the bill, for example 25,000.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click the Price cell and enter the amount of the bill, for example 25,000.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.content: Click Confirm to post the bill. It moves from Draft to Posted and becomes payable.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Confirm to post the bill. It moves from Draft to Posted and becomes payable.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Confirm to post the bill. It moves from Draft to Posted and becomes payable.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Confirm to post the bill. It moves from Draft to Posted and becomes payable.

steps.title: Register Payment
steps.content: Click Register Payment to open the payment wizard for this bill.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Register Payment to open the payment wizard for this bill.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Register Payment to open the payment wizard for this bill.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Register Payment to open the payment wizard for this bill.

steps.title: Payment journal
steps.content: Choose the bank journal the cheque is drawn on - Vendor Payment - Commercial.

content_i18n.en_US: Choose the bank journal the cheque is drawn on - Vendor Payment - Commercial.
content_i18n.si_LK: Choose the bank journal the cheque is drawn on - Vendor Payment - Commercial.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Choose the bank journal the cheque is drawn on - Vendor Payment - Commercial.

steps.title: Payment Method - Checks
steps.content: Change the Payment Method from Manual to Checks. This is the step that turns the payment into a cheque and enables cheque printing.

content_i18n.en_US: Change the Payment Method from Manual to Checks. This is the step that turns the payment into a cheque and enables cheque printing.
content_i18n.si_LK: Change the Payment Method from Manual to Checks. This is the step that turns the payment into a cheque and enables cheque printing.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Change the Payment Method from Manual to Checks. This is the step that turns the payment into a cheque and enables cheque printing.

steps.title: Create Payment
steps.content: Check the amount and payment date, then click Create Payment. The bill is now marked Paid and a cheque payment is created.

content_i18n.en_US: Check the amount and payment date, then click Create Payment. The bill is now marked Paid and a cheque payment is created.
content_i18n.si_LK: Check the amount and payment date, then click Create Payment. The bill is now marked Paid and a cheque payment is created.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Check the amount and payment date, then click Create Payment. The bill is now marked Paid and a cheque payment is created.

steps.title: Vendors
steps.content: The cheque is printed from the payment record. Open the Vendors menu again.

content_i18n.en_US: The cheque is printed from the payment record. Open the Vendors menu again.
content_i18n.si_LK: The cheque is printed from the payment record. Open the Vendors menu again.
content_i18n.ta_IN: The cheque is printed from the payment record. Open the Vendors menu again.

steps.title: Payments
steps.content: Click Payments to open the list of vendor payments.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Payments to open the list of vendor payments.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Payments to open the list of vendor payments.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Payments to open the list of vendor payments.

steps.title: Open the cheque payment
steps.content: The newest payment is at the top of the list - Payment Method Checks. Click it to open the payment.

content_i18n.en_US: The newest payment is at the top of the list - Payment Method Checks. Click it to open the payment.
content_i18n.si_LK: The newest payment is at the top of the list - Payment Method Checks. Click it to open the payment.
content_i18n.ta_IN: The newest payment is at the top of the list - Payment Method Checks. Click it to open the payment.

steps.title: Check Number assigned
steps.content: Odoo has taken the next cheque number from the journal sequence and stamped it on this payment. Amount in Words is also filled in for the cheque.

content_i18n.en_US: Odoo has taken the next cheque number from the journal sequence and stamped it on this payment. Amount in Words is also filled in for the cheque.
content_i18n.si_LK: Odoo has taken the next cheque number from the journal sequence and stamped it on this payment. Amount in Words is also filled in for the cheque.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Odoo has taken the next cheque number from the journal sequence and stamped it on this payment. Amount in Words is also filled in for the cheque.

steps.title: Cheque Number to print
steps.content: Enter the number of the physical cheque leaf you are putting into the printer. This is the number that appears on the printed cheque.

content_i18n.en_US: Enter the number of the physical cheque leaf you are putting into the printer. This is the number that appears on the printed cheque.
content_i18n.si_LK: Enter the number of the physical cheque leaf you are putting into the printer. This is the number that appears on the printed cheque.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Enter the number of the physical cheque leaf you are putting into the printer. This is the number that appears on the printed cheque.

steps.title: Print Cheque
steps.content: Click Print Cheque. (The separate Print Check button is the standard Odoo one and only marks the payment as sent - use Print Cheque for the Jinasena cheque layout.)

content_i18n.en_US: Click Print Cheque. (The separate Print Check button is the standard Odoo one and only marks the payment as sent - use Print Cheque for the Jinasena cheque layout.)
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Print Cheque. (The separate Print Check button is the standard Odoo one and only marks the payment as sent - use Print Cheque for the Jinasena cheque layout.)
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Print Cheque. (The separate Print Check button is the standard Odoo one and only marks the payment as sent - use Print Cheque for the Jinasena cheque layout.)

steps.title: Cheque Format
steps.content: Select the cheque format that matches the bank's pre-printed cheque leaf, then continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Select the cheque format that matches the bank's pre-printed cheque leaf, then continue.
content_i18n.si_LK: Select the cheque format that matches the bank's pre-printed cheque leaf, then continue.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Select the cheque format that matches the bank's pre-printed cheque leaf, then continue.

steps.title: Print
steps.content: Click Print. Odoo generates the cheque PDF - load the cheque leaf in the printer and print it. The vendor payment is now complete.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Print. Odoo generates the cheque PDF - load the cheque leaf in the printer and print it. The vendor payment is now complete.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Print. Odoo generates the cheque PDF - load the cheque leaf in the printer and print it. The vendor payment is now complete.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Print. Odoo generates the cheque PDF - load the cheque leaf in the printer and print it. The vendor payment is now complete.
